stories.title: Trump officials abandon effort to investigate election threats, experts warn

en.title: Trump officials abandon effort to investigate election threats, experts warn
en.summary: The Trump administration has discontinued key security bodies tasked with investigating threats to US elections from foreign actors and domestic terrorists, according to former officials. The administration has instead focused on unsubstantiated claims of voter fraud by noncitizens while overlooking credible election threats.

stories.title: Tennessee woman on death row taken to hospital after surviving two lethal injections

en.title: Tennessee woman on death row taken to hospital after surviving two lethal injections
en.summary: Christa Pike, convicted of murder in 1995, survived two lethal injection attempts in Tennessee and was hospitalized. Witnesses reported she was still breathing after the injections were administered, marking the second botched execution in Tennessee this year.

stories.title: Wellington beat Napoleon by picking the right venue. South Africa could do the same to Australia

en.title: Wellington beat Napoleon by picking the right venue. South Africa could do the same to Australia
en.summary: South Africa has chosen not to play a Test against Australia at the Wanderers ground in Johannesburg for strategic reasons related to venue selection.

stories.title: Chris Fagan leaves Brisbane with nothing more to prove after building one of the great AFL teams | Jonathan Horn

en.title: Chris Fagan leaves Brisbane with nothing more to prove after building one of the great AFL teams
en.summary: Chris Fagan, 65, is stepping down as Brisbane Lions coach after establishing the club's dynasty and putting it on an unprecedented upward trajectory. The excerpt discusses the emotional toll of coaching, referencing the recent AFL grand final.

stories.title: Chris Fagan steps down as Brisbane Lions coach after historic AFL premiership three-peat

en.title: Chris Fagan steps down as Brisbane Lions coach after historic AFL premiership three-peat
en.summary: Chris Fagan has resigned as Brisbane Lions coach after the team won their third consecutive AFL premiership in 2026. The 65-year-old ended his 10-year tenure despite having one year remaining on his contract.

stories.title: 'Grateful' Chris Fagan steps down from Brisbane Lions

en.title: 'Grateful' Chris Fagan steps down from Brisbane Lions
en.summary: AFL coach Chris Fagan has stepped down from the Brisbane Lions days after the team secured their third consecutive grand final victory.

stories.title: Parts of Victoria could see three months’ worth of rain as storms forecast for Australia’s south-east

en.title: Parts of Victoria could see three months' worth of rain as storms forecast for Australia's south-east
en.summary: Widespread rain and thunderstorms are expected to affect south-eastern Australia from Thursday, with Victoria forecast to receive 30 to 50mm of rain in Melbourne and severe weather also anticipated for Sydney and Canberra.

stories.title: Tennessee inmate snoring and still alive after lethal injections, witnesses say

en.title: Tennessee inmate snoring and still alive after lethal injections, witnesses say
en.summary: Christa Pike was set to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in over 200 years, though witnesses reported signs of life during the lethal injection process.

stories.title: Australia deny South Africa series sweep as Carey returns to form in rain-affected third ODI

en.title: Australia deny South Africa series sweep as Carey returns to form in rain-affected third ODI
en.summary: Australia defeated South Africa by 45 runs in a rain-interrupted third ODI, avoiding a series whitewash with contributions from Adam Carey and other players.

stories.title: Nathan Cleary has no worlds left to conquer after Dally M win

en.title: Nathan Cleary has no worlds left to conquer after Dally M win
en.summary: Nathan Cleary won his first Dally M Medal, capping a dominant career as the premier player of his generation and confirming his status among rugby league's greats.

stories.title: Nathan Cleary completes NRL boxset with his first Dally M medal

en.title: Nathan Cleary completes NRL boxset with his first Dally M medal
en.summary: Penrith's Nathan Cleary won his first Dally M Medal as the NRL's player of the year, finishing 14 points ahead of Cronulla's Braydon Trindall. Cleary was unable to attend the awards ceremony in Sydney due to an ankle injury sustained in the preliminary finals.

stories.title: Nathan Cleary accepts maiden Dally M Medal from his dad's couch

en.title: Nathan Cleary accepts maiden Dally M Medal from his dad's couch
en.summary: Injured Penrith player Nathan Cleary received his first Dally M Medal while on his father's couch. Brisbane's Tamika Upton won the NRLW award for the third time in four seasons.

en.title: 'Kath & Kim' economics catches up with Albanese and Chalmers
en.summary: The Australian Labor government's high-spending approach has diverged from the strategy of controlling inflation to reduce living costs, leaving it in a difficult economic position.

en.title: Ben Brazil wins court bid to appoint receivers over Vietjet assets
en.summary: The British High Court permitted FitzWalter Capital to appoint Alvarez & Marsal as receivers over Vietjet assets, complicating plans to establish a low-cost airline in Australia.

en.summary: Peter Freedman, billionaire founder of Røde, faces multiple legal complaints including one from his executive assistant who was copied on his critical emails.

stories.title: GM Steel hunts backers for $500m east coast scrap plant

en.title: GM Steel hunts backers for $500m east coast scrap plant
en.summary: GM Steel is seeking investors for a $500 million scrap processing facility on Australia's east coast. Early investors will receive priority access to a subsequent funding round of $250-300 million for construction.

en.title: Inside the terror and heroism on Flight FZ1073 to Tel Aviv
en.summary: A flight to Tel Aviv carrying 174 passengers, including Sydney residents Steven and Carol Moss, experienced a critical incident that was averted through the brave actions of several passengers.
